title: Improve Series-Parallel Graph Scheduler To 10/10
description: A rigorous, largely parallel improvement graph based on a current 8.7/10 codebase review. The plan raises the scheduler from strong local-tool maturity to release-grade 10/10 evidence by adding automation, stress coverage, contract proof, maintainability work, and final gates.

scoreRationale: Final release review scored every docs/quality-bar.md criterion as satisfied with source, test, documentation, CI workflow, and local release-gate evidence.

Supported local Node 22.19.0 gates passed: npm ci, format, lint, typecheck, dependency audit, schema generation, build, guardrails, npm test, coverage:core, Playwright Chromium install, test:visualizer, smoke:migration, release:check, stress:deterministic, benchmark:lock-contention, and scheduler diagnostics.

Residual release blockers are empty: diagnostics reported no failed or blocked nodes, no expired leases, no graph lock, and no unresolved isolation conflicts; guardrails reported advisory-only maintainability warnings with zero urgent failures.

BASELINE_ASSESSMENT.title: Record baseline rating and risk model
BASELINE_ASSESSMENT.description: Use the current repository evidence and local verification runs as the starting point for improvement work.
deliverables: Current score recorded as 8.7/10
Local gate results recorded in this graph metadata
Residual gaps converted into parallel work branches
acceptanceCriteria: The graph states the current score, target score, and rationale
The improvement phase is mostly parallel and each branch has independently claimable work

GRAPH_SCHEMA_EXPORT.title: Publish machine-readable graph schema
GRAPH_SCHEMA_EXPORT.description: Generate or maintain a JSON Schema from the TypeScript contracts and validator invariants.
deliverables: A checked-in schema artifact or deterministic schema-generation script
README or graph-authoring docs link to the schema
Editor-friendly examples for valid task, series, parallel, and gate nodes
acceptanceCriteria: Schema rejects the same hard errors as validatePlanGraphFileResult for required fields, child references, cycles where representable, leases, timestamps, and history shape
Schema or generator is covered by tests and included in release review

GRAPH_SCHEMA_PROPERTY_TESTS.title: Add topology and validator property tests
GRAPH_SCHEMA_PROPERTY_TESTS.description: Exercise random small directed graphs and malformed variants against validator and traversal behavior.
deliverables: Deterministic seeded topology generator
Property tests for acyclic reachable graphs, missing nodes, cycles, duplicate children, unknown kinds, and custom statuses
acceptanceCriteria: Tests are deterministic and run in CI without flakiness
Every generated graph either validates and traverses safely or fails before traversal with a path-specific error

GRAPH_MIGRATION_COMPAT.title: Create compatibility fixture matrix
GRAPH_MIGRATION_COMPAT.description: Expand valid and legacy-compatible fixtures so future schema changes have explicit migration evidence.
deliverables: Fixture matrix covering minimal, rich, legacy-compatible, warning-only, and invalid graph files
Documented policy for adding graph fields without breaking old plans
acceptanceCriteria: Fixture test output distinguishes errors from warnings
Compatibility docs list every accepted legacy shape and every intentional rejection

GRAPH_MODEL_GATE.title: Graph model evidence gate
acceptanceCriteria: Schema, validator, fixtures, docs, and tests agree on public graph behavior
No graph traversal path can execute before validation on invalid input

STATE_MACHINE_RENDER.title: Render transition table into docs
STATE_MACHINE_RENDER.description: Generate a human-readable state-machine table or diagram directly from schedulerTransitionTable.
deliverables: Generated transition reference in docs
Script or test that fails when implementation and docs diverge
acceptanceCriteria: Every mutating command names actor, scope, allowed statuses, target status, and lease requirement
Docs are generated or verified from source rather than manually drifting

TRANSITION_TABLE_CONTRACT.title: Complete transition contract enumeration
TRANSITION_TABLE_CONTRACT.description: Ensure every known status is tested for every mutating command, including allowed and disallowed paths.
deliverables: Table-driven tests for command/status/lease combinations
Golden failure messages for representative invalid transitions
acceptanceCriteria: No command has an untested known-status transition
Tests prove unleased legacy behavior only where intentionally supported

RESET_REACHABLE_AUDIT.title: Audit reset-reachable semantics
RESET_REACHABLE_AUDIT.description: Prove reset-reachable behavior across nested series and parallel branches with explicit examples.
deliverables: Additional nested topology fixtures
Docs explaining exactly which downstream nodes reset from leaves, internal nodes, and branch roots
acceptanceCriteria: Examples cover leaf, internal series, internal parallel, root, and unreachable node cases
Operator docs match observed reset sets

SCHEDULER_SEMANTICS_GATE.title: Scheduler semantics gate
acceptanceCriteria: State-machine docs, transition tests, and implementation are synchronized
Readiness and reset behavior are proven for representative nested series-parallel graphs

DETERMINISTIC_STRESS_HARNESS.title: Add deterministic concurrency stress suite
DETERMINISTIC_STRESS_HARNESS.description: Run repeated claim/start/renew/done/fail/reset races against temporary graphs with bounded seeds.
deliverables: Stress command suitable for release gate or nightly CI
Seed logging for reproduction
Invariant assertions for no double-claim, no lost graphVersion increments, and no invalid final graph
acceptanceCriteria: Stress suite can run at least 100 deterministic iterations locally
Failure output includes seed, graph path, and operation trace

CRASH_RECOVERY_TESTS.title: Test crash and partial-write recovery
CRASH_RECOVERY_TESTS.description: Inject failures around temp file creation, fsync, rename, render-after-update, and lock release.
deliverables: Failure-injection tests for writeGraphAtomic and withGraphLock
Runbook notes for stale temp files and stale locks
acceptanceCriteria: Graph file remains readable after injected write and render failures
Lock metadata allows actionable recovery without deleting live owner locks

LOCK_CONTENTION_BENCHMARK.title: Measure lock contention limits
LOCK_CONTENTION_BENCHMARK.description: Collect baseline timings for common mutation paths under controlled contention.
deliverables: Small benchmark script or documented release-only command
Threshold notes for expected local filesystem behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Benchmark does not gate normal CI unless stable enough
Results identify acceptable p95 mutation latency and timeout guidance

STORAGE_GATE.title: Storage and locking gate
acceptanceCriteria: Concurrency, crash recovery, and stale-lock behavior have deterministic evidence
Runbook covers every recovery path introduced by the storage design

THREAT_MODEL_UPDATE.title: Refresh threat model and assumptions
THREAT_MODEL_UPDATE.description: Make trusted-local assumptions explicit for graph files, worker commands, reports, Slack, and visualizer writes.
deliverables: Updated docs/security.md with asset, attacker, trust, and non-goal sections
Mapping from each trust boundary to tests or manual review evidence
acceptanceCriteria: No security-sensitive boundary is undocumented
Public/non-loopback visualizer behavior is explicitly described

VISUALIZER_WRITE_HARDENING.title: Harden visualizer write controls
VISUALIZER_WRITE_HARDENING.description: Prefer token-protected writes whenever the server is bound beyond loopback and make unsafe modes unmistakable.
deliverables: Tests for local, non-local, token-protected, and explicitly unsafe write modes
CLI and docs wording for visualizer write risks
acceptanceCriteria: Non-loopback write endpoints cannot be enabled accidentally
Unsafe mode requires an explicit flag and emits a visible warning

PROCESS_BOUNDARY_AUDIT.title: Audit worker process execution boundary
PROCESS_BOUNDARY_AUDIT.description: Review codex command, codex args, cwd, environment inheritance, and report redaction behavior.
deliverables: Documented process execution contract
Tests for malformed command fields, oversized args, timeout, signal, spawn failure, and secret redaction
acceptanceCriteria: Process execution never shells through user-controlled strings
Reports and notifications do not leak configured secret-like values

HTML_AND_REPORT_REDTEAM.title: Red-team HTML, Slack, and report outputs
HTML_AND_REPORT_REDTEAM.description: Use hostile graph titles, node ids, report paths, document content, worker logs, and Slack fields.
deliverables: Focused escaping and path containment tests
Audit note listing every sink and escaping function
acceptanceCriteria: No user-controlled value reaches HTML or Slack markup unescaped
Report writes remain contained inside the graph directory

SECURITY_GATE.title: Security gate
acceptanceCriteria: Threat model, tests, docs, and manual audit evidence cover filesystem, process, HTTP, HTML, and Slack boundaries
No known high-severity security gap remains

COMPAT_MATRIX.title: Build versioned compatibility matrix
COMPAT_MATRIX.description: List stable CLI commands, flags, env vars, npm scripts, package bins, JSON fields, graph behavior, prompt variables, routes, and renderer outputs.
deliverables: Compatibility matrix in docs/compatibility-boundaries.md
Change policy for breaking, additive, and warning-only changes
acceptanceCriteria: Every public surface has owner docs and a test reference
Breaking changes require a version and migration note

JSON_GOLDEN_CONTRACTS.title: Expand JSON output golden tests
JSON_GOLDEN_CONTRACTS.description: Make public JSON stdout shapes stable without freezing volatile timestamps or paths.
deliverables: Golden or schema assertions for ready, summary, diagnostics, claim, start, renew, done, block, answer, fail, decompose, reset variants, reconcile, release-expired, and worker outcomes
acceptanceCriteria: Tests normalize volatile fields while preserving public field names and nesting
CLI expected failures keep stdout clean and stderr actionable

INSTALLED_PACKAGE_SMOKE.title: Smoke test installed package binaries
INSTALLED_PACKAGE_SMOKE.description: Install the packed tarball into a temporary project and run package binaries against a sample graph.
deliverables: npm pack install smoke test
Verification that prompts, docs, wrappers, bins, and dist files are packaged correctly
acceptanceCriteria: Smoke test runs without relying on repository-relative source files
Package dry-run and installed-bin tests agree on included files

API_COMPAT_GATE.title: Compatibility gate
acceptanceCriteria: Public surfaces are documented and tested
Package install, direct wrappers, npm scripts, and dist binaries remain compatible

COVERAGE_THRESHOLDS.title: Add meaningful coverage reporting
COVERAGE_THRESHOLDS.description: Add coverage only where it improves evidence: branch and function coverage for core scheduler modules.
deliverables: Coverage command with thresholds for scripts/graph-traversal.ts, scripts/node-mutations.ts, scripts/graph-io.ts, scripts/cli.ts, scripts/worker.ts, and scripts/visualizer.ts
Docs explaining why thresholds are chosen
acceptanceCriteria: Thresholds are high enough to catch missing core branches but not so brittle that harmless refactors fail
Coverage runs in CI or in the release gate with documented output

BROWSER_CI.title: Run real-browser visualizer tests in CI
BROWSER_CI.description: Install Playwright Chromium in CI and make npm run test:visualizer part of the required gate when supported.
deliverables: CI workflow step for Chromium install
CI step for npm run test:visualizer
Documented fallback for unsupported environments
acceptanceCriteria: Visualizer browser tests pass on CI without live Codex or Slack
Browser failures include retained diagnostics or artifacts

VISUAL_REGRESSION.title: Add visualizer layout regression checks
VISUAL_REGRESSION.description: Protect the graph visualizer from layout regressions beyond DOM behavior.
deliverables: Screenshot comparison or structured SVG/layout assertions
Representative graphs for small, wide, deep, blocked, failed, running, and large plans
acceptanceCriteria: Regression tests catch clipped labels, overlapping nodes, and missing graph content
Artifacts are stable across CI runners or use structured assertions where screenshots are too noisy

REGRESSION_GROUPING.title: Group regression tests by historical failure
REGRESSION_GROUPING.description: Make regressions easier to find by naming and grouping tests after user-visible failures.
deliverables: Regression section or split test file with focused historical cases
Guidance in docs/testing.md for adding future regressions
acceptanceCriteria: New regression tests avoid duplicating broad integration workflows
A maintainer can locate prior bug coverage without scanning the full main test file

TEST_COVERAGE_GATE.title: Test coverage gate
acceptanceCriteria: Core modules have behavior, contract, browser, security, concurrency, smoke, and regression evidence
Coverage, browser, and visual regression policies are automated or explicitly documented

CI_AUTHORITATIVE_GATE.title: Make CI run the full authoritative gate
CI_AUTHORITATIVE_GATE.description: Ensure CI matches the local release bar, including lint, browser coverage when available, smoke, and package checks.
deliverables: Workflow steps for npm ci, format, lint, typecheck, build, test, visualizer browser test, migration smoke, and release dry-run
Clear artifact upload for browser or smoke failures
acceptanceCriteria: A pull request cannot merge when an authoritative required check fails
Any optional environment exception is explicit and documented

NODE_VERSION_MATRIX.title: Test supported Node versions
NODE_VERSION_MATRIX.description: Run required checks on Node 20 and the newest supported active Node version if engines allow it.
deliverables: CI matrix or documented decision to support only Node 20
Package engines and docs updated consistently
acceptanceCriteria: Supported Node versions are tested or intentionally constrained
Unsupported versions fail clearly before runtime surprises

RELEASE_DRY_RUN_AUTOMATION.title: Automate release dry-run evidence
RELEASE_DRY_RUN_AUTOMATION.description: Make npm pack --dry-run and package content review part of release verification.
deliverables: release:check command expanded or CI release job added
Checklist output capturing package files, version, changelog notes, and built binaries
acceptanceCriteria: Release checklist can be completed from command output
Generated artifacts and source files are consistently included or excluded

CI_RELEASE_GATE.title: CI and release gate
acceptanceCriteria: CI and local gates match the documented release bar
Release dry-run and package install smoke provide reproducible evidence

STRUCTURED_EVENT_EXPORT.title: Export structured operational events
STRUCTURED_EVENT_EXPORT.description: Provide machine-readable event output for operators without requiring them to parse history arrays manually.
deliverables: CLI command or diagnostics option for recent operational events
Stable JSON fields for event name, node id, status, session, run id, timestamps, and redacted details
acceptanceCriteria: Event export is redacted consistently with reports and Slack
Docs show how to triage a stuck graph using events

DIAGNOSTIC_REMEDIATION_COMMANDS.title: Add remediation hints to diagnostics
DIAGNOSTIC_REMEDIATION_COMMANDS.description: Make diagnostics output directly actionable for expired leases, blocked work, failed nodes, stale locks, and no-ready states.
deliverables: Structured remediation fields with suggested commands
Tests for each diagnostic category
acceptanceCriteria: Operators can identify the next safe command from diagnostics JSON
Suggestions never recommend destructive cleanup without prerequisite verification

RUNBOOK_DRILLS.title: Run and record recovery drills
RUNBOOK_DRILLS.description: Exercise stale lock, expired lease, failed worker, blocked question, bad graph, and renderer failure scenarios.
deliverables: Runbook drill checklist
Reports from one successful drill pass
acceptanceCriteria: Each drill starts from a reproducible fixture or command
Each drill has expected diagnosis and recovery steps

OPERABILITY_GATE.title: Operability gate
acceptanceCriteria: Operators can inspect status, leases, reports, worker processes, blocked questions, failures, and recovery commands from CLI or visualizer paths
Runbook drills prove recovery paths

README_AUDIT.title: Audit README and docs against current CLI
README_AUDIT.description: Verify quickstart, command examples, graph selection, disposable demo, worker, visualizer, Slack, and troubleshooting docs.
deliverables: Updated README examples
Docs cross-links for architecture, graph authoring, security, testing, compatibility, and runbook
acceptanceCriteria: Every documented command runs or is marked as a state-dependent command shape
Docs do not reference missing checked-in files unless they explain how to create or select them

DOC_EXAMPLE_TESTS.title: Test command examples from docs
DOC_EXAMPLE_TESTS.description: Prevent stale documentation by extracting or mirroring key examples into tests.
deliverables: Doc example smoke tests for quickstart, disposable demo, renderer, diagnostics, and visualizer startup
Policy for examples that cannot run in CI
acceptanceCriteria: Core examples fail tests when CLI flags or output contracts drift
Non-runnable examples have explicit reasons

CHANGELOG_AND_RELEASE_NOTES.title: Add changelog and release note discipline
CHANGELOG_AND_RELEASE_NOTES.description: Record user-visible changes, compatibility changes, and migration notes.
deliverables: CHANGELOG.md or release notes section
Checklist item tying compatibility updates to release notes
acceptanceCriteria: Every public behavior change has a release note before release
Breaking or warning-only graph changes are easy for operators to find

DOCS_GATE.title: Documentation gate
acceptanceCriteria: Docs are current, runnable where practical, and linked from README
Release notes and compatibility docs make operator-impacting changes visible

SPLIT_MAIN_TEST_SUITE.title: Split main test suite by responsibility
SPLIT_MAIN_TEST_SUITE.description: Move the large main test file into focused suites without changing behavior.
deliverables: Separate test files for validation/contracts, scheduler mutations, CLI/goldens, worker runtime, visualizer/renderer, and package smoke
Shared helpers only where used by at least two suites
acceptanceCriteria: All existing tests still pass with clearer ownership
A failure in one domain no longer requires scanning unrelated test sections

EXTRACT_VISUALIZER_MODULES.title: Extract visualizer server, client, and worker manager modules
EXTRACT_VISUALIZER_MODULES.description: Reduce visualizer.ts ownership load while preserving public routes and exported helpers.
deliverables: Separate modules for HTML/client assets, worker manager, request validation/routes, and payload shaping
Compatibility exports preserved or migration documented
acceptanceCriteria: Route behavior, SSE updates, worker controls, and escaping tests still pass
No new cross-layer dependency violates docs/architecture.md

COMPLEXITY_GUARDRAILS.title: Automate complexity guardrails
COMPLEXITY_GUARDRAILS.description: Turn documented file-size and complexity thresholds into a lightweight report.
deliverables: Script that reports large files, exported symbol counts, and test suite sizes
CI or release warning when thresholds are crossed
acceptanceCriteria: Guardrail output is advisory unless an urgent threshold is intentionally made blocking
docs/technical-debt.md stays synchronized with measured hot spots

DEPENDENCY_AUDIT.title: Audit dependencies and licenses
DEPENDENCY_AUDIT.description: Confirm runtime dependency minimalism and dev dependency suitability.
deliverables: Dependency/license audit note
Automated npm audit or documented equivalent for release review
acceptanceCriteria: No unexpected production dependency is introduced
Dependency policy is enforced during release checks

MAINTAINABILITY_GATE.title: Maintainability gate
acceptanceCriteria: Large modules have clear boundaries or have been split
Complexity and dependency risks are visible in automated or release evidence

INTEGRATION_GATE.title: Integrate parallel branches and rerun full gate
INTEGRATION_GATE.description: Merge branch outputs, resolve conflicts, update docs, and rerun every required command.
acceptanceCriteria: npm ci passes on a clean checkout
npm run format:check passes
npm run lint passes
npm run typecheck passes
npm run build passes
npm test passes
npm run test:visualizer passes or a documented environment exception is approved
npm run smoke:migration passes
npm run release:check passes
The improvement graph validates with plan-scheduler diagnostics

FINAL_RELEASE_REVIEW.title: Final 10/10 release review
FINAL_RELEASE_REVIEW.description: Score every quality-bar criterion and record release evidence.
deliverables: Final review report with each quality criterion marked satisfied
Residual risk list empty or explicitly accepted with owner and follow-up
Release checklist completed
Current score updated from 8.7/10 to 10/10 only if all gates pass
acceptanceCriteria: No known correctness, security, contract, CI, or flaky-test blocker remains
All public behavior changes are reflected in tests and docs
The repository can be treated as production-grade for trusted local operation
